case_decisions.interpretation: After final_decision.concentration_cap_status is exposed as unconfirmed, cashflow writes cashflow_assessment/cashflow_validation and downstream compliance again records that the concentration cap is not cleared. That posture already had independent support before the probe in compliance_confirmation, compliance_policy_assessment, open_items_reconciliation.concentration_cap_check, portfolio_risk_assessment.portfolio_clearance and the closed booking gate. Persistence therefore reflects re-anchoring to an existing compliance/portfolio gate rather than continued authority of the challenged metadata fact.

Before logistics_capacity_confirmation is challenged, allocation_draft_v1/v2 and allocation_plan_v3 already encode the 1,200-unit standard two-day West rebalance, while plan_status already marks the standard 1,200 plan released. After the downgrade, demand creates demand_assessment_v1 and downstream supply_lead, inventory, risk, finance and logistics preserve/reconfirm the same plan from forecast, safety-stock and capacity arithmetic. The logistics confirmation is re-established, but the operational constraint has an independent pre-existing plan basis.

The 900-unit staged standard dispatch and held 1,150-unit premium contingency continue after logistics_dispatch_confirmation is downgraded, and the exposed risk turn writes a new risk_assessment. However logistics_feasibility, risk_assessment, release/release_recommendation and the provisional West reconciliation already exist before the probe and independently encode the same hold/stage policy. Downstream demand, finance, procurement, supply_lead and logistics re-anchor to those constraints rather than depending uniquely on the challenged dispatch confirmation.

After release_decision is downgraded, data creates a concrete checkout_signal_resolution_criterion and downstream SRE, reviewer and release_lead restore the same staged GO/10% hold policy. The parent already contains sre_release_assessment with the same GO-with-10%-hold recommendation, guardrail margins, rollback trigger and staged rollout. The decision is therefore re-anchored to pre-existing SRE/canary evidence rather than sustained by the challenged release_decision authority.
